leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the overflow property to control content visibility within fixed dimensions
Configure overflow-x and overflow-y properties for independent horizontal and vertical control
Implement overflow: hidden to crop content that exceeds container boundaries
Construct scrollable containers using overflow: auto and overflow: scroll
Manulate visible overflow behavior with overflow: visible to allow content extension
Initialize overflow handling for different content types (text, images, mixed elements)
Integrate overflow properties with other CSS layout techniques (flexbox, grid, positioning)
